definition: qesR study code.
Year of the study; for qes_crop_2007_2010, the year each monthly poll began.
English name of the study, from the qesR catalog.
Respondent identifier: the study's identifier variables joined by '-' (qesR's qes_id without its study prefix), or <study>_<row> where the file has none (qes2014).
note: qes2007_panel identifiers join the project and the questionnaire number (nompn-quest), unique since qesR 0.7.0; qes2018_panel's join the interview mode and id.

definition: The file's questionnaire number (QUEST), as in qesR 0.4.4 (one number repeats).
Interview start date-time as text, where the file has one (qes2022 and, as a date, qes2014).
Interview end date-time as text (qes2022 only).
Date-time the answers were recorded, as text (qes2022 only).
Mother tongue: French, English or Other; a respondent who reports two first languages is NA (not assigned to either).
note: qes2022 is NA until its three-part mother-tongue question is harmonized.

definition: Every qes1998 respondent is French: the polls interviewed francophones only (a sample restriction, not an answer).
note: The value comes from the sampling restriction, not from an answer, and the restriction differs by firm (the stratum firme_post): the CREATEC rows (firme_post = 1) are mother tongue French by design (codebook 332050); the 426 CROP rows (firme_post = 2) were kept for speaking French most often at home (codebook 332049, q22), so for them this is the home language, not a measured mother tongue. The pooled definition is not confirmed yet.

definition: Citizenship, where the study asked (qes2022 only).
Year of birth.
Age in years: the age item where the study asked it, else the year of the study minus the year of birth (as qesR 0.4.4 computed it).
note: An age computed from the year of birth can be one year too high.

definition: Age group: six bands (18-24 ... 65+) from the age where it is known, else the study's six bands, else its three bands (18-34, 35-54, 55+); under 18 is NA.
note: qes2018_panel has only three bands (18-34, 35-54, 55+).

definition: Gender: Man, Woman; qes2022 also Non-binary and Other.
Province: Quebec for every respondent (every study sampled Quebec residents).
note: Regional information is in the study files (get_qes()).

definition: Highest level of education in four groups; from the highest level completed where the study asks for it, from years of schooling otherwise.
Household income in each study's own brackets (their text) or, for qes2022, the amount; not comparable across studies.
Religion in each study's own categories (their text).
note: Respondents with no religion are NA where the religion item was asked only of those who have one (qes2012 and qes2014; in qes_harmonize() their NA reason is inapplicable, or refused when they declined the filter question).

definition: Born in Canada: Yes or No.
Interest on 0-10: four-point items coded 10, 7, 3 and 0 from most to least interested, 0-10 items as answered; interest in politics where the study asks it, else interest in the campaign or election.
note: Mixes four-point and 0-10 instruments, and general and campaign interest; for analysis use the targets interest_4pt and interest_0_10 of qes_harmonize(), never pooled.

definition: Left-right self-placement, 0 (left) to 10 (right).
Reported turnout in the provincial election of the study: 1 voted, 0 did not.
note: Only reported turnout, asked after the election; see turnout_intent for the campaign-period likelihood of voting.
The CROP polls asked only a vote intention (see vote_intent), not the reported vote or turnout.

definition: Party the respondent reported voting for in the provincial election of the study; nonvoters, spoiled ballots, don't know and refusals are NA.
note: Only the reported vote; see vote_intent and vote_choice_timing. Parties by their usual abbreviation (PLQ, PQ, CAQ, QS, PVQ, PCQ, ON, ADQ), Other party, and Did not vote / None for an intention of no party or a party identification of none.
The CROP polls asked only a vote intention (see vote_intent), not the reported vote or turnout.

definition: Typed answer for another party on the reported-vote question.
note: Not harmonized yet: every value is NA (the 0.4.4 sources were other questions or the vote intention).

definition: No valid source in any study: every value is NA.
note: Each study's 0.4.4 source was another question (importance of voting, best campaign, best party on an issue).

definition: No valid source in any study: every value is NA.
note: A different construct in each study in qesR 0.4.4 (second choice, hypothetical vote, the vote intention itself).

definition: Would vote Yes (1) or No (0) in a referendum on Quebec becoming an independent country; would not vote is NA.
note: Only that question; see sov_partnership_1995 and sovereignty_item.

Asked the 1995 question (sovereignty with an offer of partnership), not the independent-country question; see sov_partnership_1995 (for qes2007_panel, qesR 0.4.4 read intref, which combines it with the question put to the undecided).
Asked about a sovereign country (pays souverain), not the independent-country referendum question.

The variable label gives only the first words of the first referendum question (intvoterefa) and no questionnaire is deposited, so whether it asks about an independent country, a sovereign country or sovereignty with an offer of partnership is unknown, and it is not mapped; qesR 0.4.4 read intvoteref, which combines it with the question put to the undecided (intvoterefb), and such follow-up questions are never used.
Asked a favourable/opposed scale, not a referendum vote.

definition: Same as sovereignty_support.

Asked about a sovereign country (pays souverain), not the independent-country referendum question.

definition: Federal party identification: Liberal, Conservative, NDP, Bloc Quebecois, Green, PPC, Other party, or Did not vote / None for none.
Provincial party identification, parties as in vote_choice; Did not vote / None for none.
Each study's own survey weight, on its own scale, as in qesR 0.4.4.
note: Not normalized: study means range from 1 to about 6. See weight_pre and weight_post for the recommended weights of the spec.

definition: When the question in vote_choice was asked in each study: post (after the election), or NA where vote_choice has no value.
Which question sovereignty_support holds in each study: sov_indep (referendum on an independent country), or NA where it has no value.
The study's family (qes, durand_panel, crop_polls, polls_1998).
The study's design (post, pre_post, panel, pooled_polls).
The waves of the study the respondent took part in, ';'-separated (as in qes_harmonize()).
The respondent's subsample within the study, where it has several (as in qes_harmonize()).
The respondent's row in the study's file, for joining raw variables from get_qes() by qes_code and source_row.
The spec's recommended weight of the respondent's pre-election wave, as deposited (not normalized); NA where it is not documented yet.
The spec's recommended weight of the respondent's post-election wave, as deposited (not normalized); NA where it is not documented yet.
Provincial vote intention at the first question, asked before the election, parties as in vote_choice; Did not vote / None for would not vote, none or would spoil.
Likelihood of voting in the provincial election, asked before it (qes2022 only).
Would vote Yes (1) or No (0) on the 1995 referendum question (sovereignty with an offer of partnership); would not vote is NA.

Canadian citizen (Yes, No), where asked.
Year of birth.

Education in four groups.
Interest on 0-10, as the master's political_interest.
